verdict.rationale: Kong documents load balancing that distributes requests across multiple LLM models and an AI Rate Limiting Advanced plugin for enforcing rate limits, which together cover throttling and traffic spreading. The evidence does not show spreading traffic across multiple provider API keys or credentials, nor any request queuing to absorb provider rate-limit pressure. missing for 10: explicit multi-key/credential rotation for the same provider, request queuing or backoff behavior, detail on the rate-limiting plugin beyond its name, independent or hands-on corroboration.
